name: Hue
author: mathisarends
description: Philips Hue in the Omarchy bar: rooms, zones, scenes, brightness and favorites, powered by the huego CLI.

barWidget.description: One bulb in the bar. Click for a keyboard-first panel with every room and zone, their scenes and brightness, and your own favorites.

schema.label: Bar icon controls
schema.description: home, room:<name> or zone:<name>. The icon, scroll wheel and right click act on it.

schema.label: Brightness step (%)
schema.description: How far one scroll notch or one arrow key moves the brightness.

schema.label: Fade (seconds)
schema.description: Fade time for switching, dimming and scenes. 0 keeps the bridge default.

schema.label: Show key hints
schema.description: The short shortcut line at the bottom of the panel.

schema.label: huego command
schema.description: Name or full path of the huego binary.
